about: The SAME input as user.full.capi.json, serialized for the Measurement Pixel's oaiq("init", { user }) call. Singular keys, scalar values, and four fields absent entirely. Holding these two fixtures side by side is what makes the Pixel/CAPI asymmetry impossible to implement in only one runtime.
asserts: Identical digests to user.full.capi.json - only the key names and cardinality differ.
obref, ip_address, user_agent and android_advertising_id are ABSENT: they are marked "pixel": null in user.json because the browser supplies them itself.
No key in this object is plural.
Where a caller supplied several values for one attribute, the Pixel receives the first.
